traits.leaf_arrangement.note: APweb, Nymphaeales page (read 2026-10-16): order leaves spiral (one per node); Cabomba submerged leaves opposite or whorled.

traits.phyllotaxis_pattern.note: APweb, Nymphaeales page (read 2026-10-16): order characterisation gives spiral leaves with short internodes.

traits.leaf_division.note: APweb, Nymphaeales page (read 2026-10-16): floating blades whole (cordate to peltate); Hydatellaceae linear; Cabomba submerged blades finely dissected but still one blade.

traits.rosette.note: APweb, Nymphaeales page (read 2026-10-16): Nymphaeaceae aquatic rosette plants with little stem; Hydatellaceae small tufted herbs; Cabombaceae long internodes (no rosette).

traits.life_span.note: APweb, Nymphaeales page (read 2026-10-16): Nymphaeaceae perennial, rarely annual; Hydatellaceae often annual.

traits.flowering_position.note: APweb, Nymphaeales page (read 2026-10-16): Nymphaeaceae flowers lateral in the leaf spiral; Cabombaceae extra-axillary; Hydatellaceae axillary heads.

traits.sexual_system.note: APweb, Nymphaeales page (read 2026-10-16): Nymphaeaceae and Cabombaceae flowers bisexual (APweb does not say otherwise; perfect flowers with stamens and carpels described); Hydatellaceae monoecious.
